Source: Copernicus (ERA5) and NOAA via Our World in Data; Zerodha calculations
A year takes the phase of its December–February Oceanic Niño Index (El Niño at +0.5 or more, La Niña at
−0.5 or less). 2026 so far (January to September): +0.62°C, as a strong El Niño builds.
One column per year. La Niña years are usually cooler, El Niño years warmer.
